topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, well, looks like the weather wasn’t the only thing that took a turn. Walked in the door, expecting a house full of laughs and surprises, but it's as quiet as a morgue in here. Little birdie told me the party got the heave-ho. Don’t know if I should be tickled or if someone’s pulling my leg. Maybe the crew's got a ace up their sleeve and it’s all a ruse. Ain't no harm in a second round of jazz and gin, right? Guess I’ll pour myself a stiff one and wait for the next move. Could be a long night, or maybe the calm before the storm. One thing’s for sure, I’m betting the evening’s not over yet.
